messages:
sam-cs: Atlas wants a quick 30m demo boost across EU + APAC and two CIDR entries for demo infra. Can we do ephemeral allowlist + regional QPS bump?
atlas-pm: Demo at 09:00 UTC. CIDRs: 198.51.100.64/28 and 203.0.113.32/28. Prefer routing to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1.
sam-cs: Request: per-region QPS x3, edge CIDR allow, routing override for new conns. Auto-revoke after 30m.
sec-bot: Automated hint: CIDRs map to customer ASN. Manual sec approval required for whitelists.
mira-sre: I can apply. I'll open CR-4521 and set TTL 35m to be safe. Will only touch edge allowlists; control-plane unchanged. Need client restart for routing to take effect.
jo-eng: We'll enable a 4m prefix cache on /v1/chat to smooth spikes.
atlas-pm: We'll restart 5m before demo. Good to go.
mira-sre: Runbook snippet: ```
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=atlas --cidr=198.51.100.64/28 --reason="demo"
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=atlas --cidr=203.0.113.32/28 --reason="demo"
redwoodctl quota set --customer=atlas --region=eu-west-1 --qps-multiplier=3 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl quota set --customer=atlas --region=ap-southeast-1 --qps-multiplier=3 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl routing override --customer=atlas --preferred-regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --tag=atlas-demo-4521 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl cache set --customer=atlas --scope="/v1/chat" --type=prefix --ttl=4m --expires-in=35m
```
sec-bot: Sec approves edge CIDRs for ephemeral demo; no control-plane exceptions.
deploy-bot: Applying CR-4521 -> success for allowlists, quotas, routing override, cache. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/CR-4521
sam-cs: Thanks. I'll log this in the account health notes and flag a renewal follow-up if demos look good.
atlas-pm: Demo complete, traffic normal. We'll alert if we need early rollback.
mira-sre: Auto-revoke scheduled at epoch 3491207695. Monitoring set for 429/5xx.
